scale.labels: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-yellow-500

rules: Use Playfair Display for all major headings. Never use Inter for headings.
Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headings.
Uppercase tracking-widest for overlines and small labels.
Ensure heading color contrast meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio against dark backgrounds.
Never use pure black (#000000). Use #050505 (Deep Void) as the base.
Sponsor and partner logos must appear in premium white-card treatment to ensure readability on the dark site.
Use gold and champagne primarily for interactions, accents, and prominent BUY TICKETS CTAs.

layouts.grid_system: Bento-style and strict asymmetrical grids for visual tension. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with gap-8 to gap-12.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. Use py-24, py-32 for sections to give breathing room.
layouts.container: Max width 7xl, center aligned but content itself should often be left-aligned for reading flow.
sections: Hero: Large kinetic hero, masked line-by-line reveal, countdown timer.
Initiative By: 3 Organiser logos under the hero.
The Show / 90s with 90: Numbered manifesto chapters, stats, quotes.
Partners: White cards on dark background for logos.

rules: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
Framer Motion for scroll reveals (e.g., masking line-by-line for headings).
One slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee for partners or news.
Hover effects on cards should be subtle lifts (-translate-y-1) and soft gold glows.

effects: Cinematic stage lighting effects using subtle radial gradients (e.g., radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(212,175,55,0.1), transparent 50%)).
White-card treatment for partner logos: bg-white text-black with subtle inner shadow.
3d_libraries: Use Framer Motion 3D or react-spring-parallax for a subtle parallax or 3D hero moment.

rules: Always customize Shadcn to fit the cinematic dark/gold theme.
BUY TICKETS button must be the most visually prominent element on the screen.
Use partner logos within white cards.
Team portraits should be elegant and high contrast.
Hero background should have a heavy black overlay (bg-black/60) to ensure text and branding elements pop.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for standard text and 3:1 for large headings.
accessibility.interaction: Explicitly define focus states with gold rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-yellow-500).
accessibility.aria: Include proper ARIA labels for all interactive elements, particularly the BUY TICKETS button and FAQ toggles.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use Playfair Display for headings and generous spacing to make the site feel like a premium cultural production.
Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling and Framer Motion for scroll reveals.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; use backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60.
Always use data-testid attributes for buttons, links, and forms.
Avoid generic centered layouts except for the hero. Use left-aligned bento grids and asymmetric layouts to create tension.
DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for headings. Playfair Display is mandatory.
Missing categories (like logos) MUST use the provided URLs above, NEVER placeholder text or dummy image URLs.
Add 'use client' at the top of components utilizing Framer Motion or React hooks.
